transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. What brings you in today?

Yeah, um… I guess I’m here because things have gotten kind of out of hand with how much I’m trying to do. I keep starting projects—like at work I’ll make these huge plans, and then I’m also mapping out certification schedules, redoing parts of the home network, texting old contacts about ideas… it all feels really important in the moment.

I work in systems, so some of it sounds reasonable at first, you know? Like upgrading a router or organizing a rollout plan, that’s normal for me. But then I just keep going past where most people would stop, and my wife has to tell me to shut the laptop, or my director has to step in and say, “No, we’re not doing all of this right now.” That’s basically why I came in.
Have you noticed that you’re needing less sleep lately, like feeling rested after only a few hours of sleep or not feeling tired even when you don’t get much sleep?

Yeah… yes, that’s been happening. I’ll have these stretches where I sleep maybe three hours, and then I’m just awake at like 3 or 4 in the morning, wide awake. Not like groggy-awake, but sharp, like my brain’s already booted up.

And it doesn’t feel bad at the time, which is the weird part. It feels like, oh great, I’ve got bonus time before everyone else is up. Like I can get ahead on emails or sketch something out or—well, even just reorganize stuff that probably doesn’t need reorganizing. But no, I don’t really feel tired when it happens.
Have you noticed yourself feeling unusually upbeat, overly confident, or like you're on top of the world during these periods of high activity?

Yeah… I mean, “on top of the world” sounds a little dramatic, but some weeks I do feel almost electric. Like I can handle everything, like I’m seeing the whole board at once and everyone else is still stuck on step one.

But then it flips really fast. Like if my wife asks, “Do you really need to do that right now?” or there’s some tiny delay at work, I can get… sharp. Snappy. It feels in the moment like people are trying to slow me down on purpose, even if later I can see they probably weren’t.
How long have these periods of needing very little sleep and feeling extremely energetic lasted the few times they've happened?

I think… if I’m looking at the whole pattern, it’s been going on for maybe a year and eight months? Not nonstop, obviously. It’s more like these stretches where I’m sleeping way less and I feel really driven, like everything is urgent and I’m unusually sure I can handle it.

I didn’t mark it on a calendar or anything—though I did start trying to track it once in a spreadsheet, and then the spreadsheet got way too complicated—but yeah, roughly a year and a half plus. Around a year and eight months sounds right.
